description: Ask the client's model, through sampling/createMessage, for a short draft reply. Pass ticket_id to draft from that ticket, or note for a draft with no ticket. The draft is returned and is not posted: call add_comment yourself to post it. The client must have declared capabilities.sampling on initialize and must still be connected. A one-shot POST has no model to ask and returns an error.

note.description: What the draft should cover, when there is no ticket or in addition to it.

ticket_id.description: A ticket id from run_query schema=tickets. Omitted when note is enough.

name: draft_reply
